title.en: Area bounded by a curve and the x-axis

hook.en: A farmer's field has a straight fence on three sides and a curving stream on the fourth. How do we find its exact area? Slice it into very thin strips and add them up: that is a definite integral.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಮೂರು ಬದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರ ಬೇಲಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕನೇ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಗಿದ ಹಳ್ಳ ಇದೆ. ಅದರ ನಿಖರ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಹೇಗೆ? ತೆಳುವಾದ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳಾಗಿ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ: ಅದೇ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತ ಅನುಕಲನ.

objectives.en: Find the area under a curve using vertical strips
Handle curves that lie below the x-axis
Split the integral where a curve crosses the axis

narration.en: A farmer's field has a straight fence on three sides and a curving stream on the fourth. How do we find its exact area? Slice it into very thin strips and add them up: that is a definite integral.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಮೂರು ಬದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರ ಬೇಲಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕನೇ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಗಿದ ಹಳ್ಳ ಇದೆ. ಅದರ ನಿಖರ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಹೇಗೆ? ತೆಳುವಾದ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳಾಗಿ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ: ಅದೇ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತ ಅನುಕಲನ.

title.en: Area under a curve: vertical strips

body.en: Take a thin vertical strip of height $y$ and width $dx$. Its area is $dA = y\,dx$. Adding all such strips from $x = a$ to $x = b$ gives the area bounded by the curve $y = f(x)$, the x-axis and the lines $x = a$, $x = b$.
body.kn: ಎತ್ತರ y ಮತ್ತು ಅಗಲ dx ಇರುವ ತೆಳು ಲಂಬ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ y dx. x = a ಯಿಂದ x = b ವರೆಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿದರೆ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: First sketch the curve and mark the region
Strip area = y dx; total area = ∫ y dx from a to b

narration.en: Picture a thin vertical strip of height y and width d x. Its area is y d x. Add all such strips from x equals a to x equals b, and you get the area under the curve.
narration.kn: ಎತ್ತರ y ಮತ್ತು ಅಗಲ dx ಇರುವ ತೆಳು ಲಂಬ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ y dx. x = a ಯಿಂದ x = b ವರೆಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿದರೆ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Area as a sum of strips

narration.en: The teacher builds the area under a curve from thin strips, then shows why a part below the axis must be added as an absolute value.

say.en: Here is y = x squared. We want the area under it from x = 1 to x = 3.
Cut the region into thin vertical strips. One strip has height y and width d x, so its area is y d x.
Add all the strips from 1 to 3. That sum is the definite integral.
Integrate: x cubed by 3, from 1 to 3, which is 27 by 3 minus 1 by 3, that is 26 by 3 square units.
Now y = sin x from 0 to 2 pi. The first arch is above the axis, the second is below.
The plain integral gives 2 plus minus 2, which is 0. But area is never negative, so we add the absolute values: 2 plus 2 is 4.

title.en: When the curve goes below the x-axis

body.en: If $f(x) < 0$ on $[a, b]$, the integral is negative, but area is never negative, so we take $\left|\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\right|$. If the curve crosses the axis at $x = c$, find the two parts separately and add their absolute values.
body.kn: f(x) ಋಣವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಅನುಕಲನ ಋಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಎಂದೂ ಋಣವಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬೆಲೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ ಅಕ್ಷವನ್ನು ದಾಟಿದರೆ ಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.

points.en: Never let a positive and a negative part cancel

narration.en: If the curve is below the x-axis, the integral comes out negative, but an area is never negative, so take its absolute value. If the curve crosses the axis, split the integral at the crossing point and add the absolute values.
narration.kn: f(x) ಋಣವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಅನುಕಲನ ಋಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಎಂದೂ ಋಣವಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬೆಲೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ ಅಕ್ಷವನ್ನು ದಾಟಿದರೆ ಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.

caption.en: Plot a parabola y = ax² + bx + c and see where it lies above and below the x-axis.

tryThis.en: Make the roots 0 and 2: the region between them lies below the axis.
Change a to a negative number and watch the region flip above the axis.

narration.en: Plot a parabola and look at where it lies above and below the x-axis. Make the roots 0 and 2, then change the sign of a and watch the region flip.

caption.en: y = x(x − c) dips below the axis between 0 and c. Move c and the upper limit b and compare the signed integral with the true area from 0 to b.

narration.en: Move the root c and the upper limit b. Watch how the signed integral can become zero while the area does not.

tryThis.en: Set c = 2 and b = 3: the signed integral is 0, but the area is not.
Keep c fixed and increase b: which readout grows faster?
Why is the area always at least c³/6?

problem.en: Find the area bounded by y = x², the x-axis and the lines x = 1 and x = 3.

steps.en: The curve y = x² lies above the x-axis, so Area = ∫₁³ x² dx.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the area bounded by y = x², the x-axis and the lines x = 1 and x = 3.

problem.en: Find the area bounded by y = sin x and the x-axis from x = 0 to x = 2π.

steps.en: sin x ≥ 0 on [0, π] and sin x ≤ 0 on [π, 2π].
∫_π^{2π} sin x dx = [−cos x]_π^{2π} = −1 − 1 = −2, so this part has area 2.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the area bounded by y = sin x and the x-axis from x = 0 to x = 2π.

points.en: Area under y = f(x) from a to b is the integral of y dx.
points.kn: a ಯಿಂದ b ವರೆಗೆ y = f(x) ಕೆಳಗಿನ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ y dx ನ ಅನುಕಲನ.

points.en: A region below the x-axis gives a negative integral: take its absolute value.
points.kn: x-ಅಕ್ಷದ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಭಾಗದ ಅನುಕಲನ ಋಣ: ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬೆಲೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

points.en: If the curve crosses the axis, split at the crossing and add the parts.
points.kn: ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ ಅಕ್ಷವನ್ನು ದಾಟಿದರೆ ಆ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಜಿಸಿ ಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.

Find the area bounded by y = x³ and the x-axis between x = −1 and x = 1.

narration.en: Recap. Area under y = f(x) from a to b is the integral of y dx. A region below the x-axis gives a negative integral: take its absolute value. If the curve crosses the axis, split at the crossing and add the parts.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. a ಯಿಂದ b ವರೆಗೆ y = f(x) ಕೆಳಗಿನ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ y dx ನ ಅನುಕಲನ. x-ಅಕ್ಷದ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಭಾಗದ ಅನುಕಲನ ಋಣ: ನಿರಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬೆಲೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ ಅಕ್ಷವನ್ನು ದಾಟಿದರೆ ಆ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಜಿಸಿ ಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.
